div.head: Swer 4
div.ab: On ðone Drihten, ne teo ic N. ne for hete ne for hole ne for unrihtre feohgyrnesse, ne ic nan soðre nat, bute swa min secga me sæde, 7 ic sylf to soðe talige, ðæt he mines orfes þeof wære.

[I swear] by the Lord, [that] I do not accuse N. because of hatred or slander or out of avarice, and [I know] nothing more true than what my informant told me, and what I myself consider to be true: that N. stole my cattle.

Ðæs að, þe his æhte bryideð: þæt he hit ne dæð ne for hete ne for hole. On ðone Drihten, ne te ic Ñ ne for hete ne for hole ne for unrihtre feohgyrnesse, ne ic nan soðre nat, bute swa min secga me sæde, 7 ic sylf to soðe talige, þæt he mines orfes ðeof wære.
